data_classes: Personal data; Health and injury data; Policy records

consequential_decisions: N (intake only; adjusters decide coverage and payment)

regulatory_notes: DPIA completed for health data; does not make or support coverage, pricing or claim decisions (confirmed by the AI governance owner under BAL-1.12)

tags: CODE, ENDPOINT, AGENT, ACT, EXEC, EXT, UNTRUSTED
